capabilities: Lock a hovered node's highlight with a modifier-key click
Extend the lock to connected neighbors so a colored, arrowed trail stays visible
Retrace the trail by clicking a node already on it, or start a fresh trail
Configure trail color, edge thickness, direction arrows, and trigger key
Clear the lock via commands, Esc, or Alt+Click on empty space
extras: Relies on undocumented internal Graph View APIs (isolated in src/graph-adapter.ts), so it may break on future Obsidian updates; installable via BRAT; roadmap lists multiple trails, selectable connection depth, and session persistence.
intentEvidence: It does not create a separate graph view — it works directly on top of the Graph View you already use
motivation: The author was frustrated at having to freeze the mouse in place to see a note's connections, and losing everything already seen when following a chain of links.
problem: Obsidian's Graph View clears the neighbor highlight the moment the mouse moves, making it hard to trace connections or follow a chain of links through a large vault.
summary: Graph View add-on that pins a node's hover highlight with Alt+Click and keeps a colored navigation trail of locked nodes visible.
